user.title: Fronius Gen24
user.description: Modbus TCP must be enabled on the inverter with SunSpec model type "int + SF" and control enabled.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the inverter.

error.not_sunspec: The device does not expose a SunSpec register map.
error.no_storage: No storage model (124) found. Is a battery connected and the unit ID correct?

data_description.enforce: Overwrite changes made by other Modbus clients (e.g. evcc). When off, such changes are adopted as the new setpoints.

setpoints_not_applied.title: {title}: battery setpoints not applied
setpoints_not_applied.description:
The inverter did not accept the requested battery setpoints.

Requested: `{target}`
Reported: `{actual}`

The integration keeps retrying. Check whether another Modbus client writes the same registers, or press "Return control to inverter".

set_setpoints.name: Set setpoints
set_setpoints.description: Change several battery setpoints at once. They are written in a safe order and verified. Per side only one of: limit in %, limit in W, grid power.

config_entry_id.name: Inverter
config_entry_id.description: Required if more than one inverter is configured.

discharge_limit.name: Discharge limit
discharge_limit.description: Discharge limit in percent of the maximum power. Ends charging from the grid.

charge_limit.name: Charge limit
charge_limit.description: Charge limit in percent of the maximum power. Ends discharging to the grid.

discharge_power_limit.name: Discharge power limit
discharge_power_limit.description: Discharge limit in W. Ends charging from the grid.

charge_power_limit.name: Charge power limit
charge_power_limit.description: Charge limit in W. Ends discharging to the grid.

grid_charge_power.name: Charge from grid
grid_charge_power.description: Charge the battery from the grid with this power in W, 0 ends it. Switches to "Limit discharging" and allows grid charging. Ends discharging to the grid.

grid_discharge_power.name: Discharge to grid
grid_discharge_power.description: Discharge the battery with this power in W, 0 ends it. What the house does not use goes to the grid. Ends charging from the grid.

revert_timeout.name: Revert timeout
revert_timeout.description: Seconds after which the inverter falls back to automatic operation if no new setpoints arrive. 0 disables it.

grid_charging.name: Grid charging
grid_charging.description: Allow charging the battery from the grid.
